title.justification: The paper is focused on improving Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) by introducing a Retrieval-Augmented MIL (RAM-MIL) framework.
title.quote: To address this challenge, this paper introduces the Retrieval-AugMented MIL (RAM-MIL) framework, which integrates Optimal Transport (OT) as the distance metric for nearest neighbor retrieval.

extractions.description: The paper presents the Retrieval-Augmented MIL (RAM-MIL) framework, designed to enhance the performance of Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) models, especially in out-of-domain scenarios. The framework utilizes Optimal Transport (OT) to improve nearest neighbor retrieval, thereby reducing performance degradation when distribution shifts occur. This approach also facilitates an interpretable model through visualizations of the transportation matrix, making the retrieval results understandable at the instance level. RAM-MIL achieves state-of-the-art performance in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, with applications mainly in medical diagnosis domain using whole slide images (WSI).

applications.quote: Empirical evaluations conducted on WSI classification demonstrate that the proposed RAM-MIL framework achieves state-of-the-art performance in both in-domain scenarios, where the training and retrieval data are in the same domain, and more crucially, in out-of-domain scenarios, where the (unlabeled) retrieval data originates from a different domain.
